![](../images/events/summer-school-2025.jpg)

The MIDSEA Summer School returned in 2025, hosted by Universitas Gadjah Mada
in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, from 23-29 June. Building on the success of the
2024 edition in Vietnam, this year's programme offered parallel tracks
covering both foundational and advanced disease modelling concepts, plus
plenty of opportunities to network with modellers from across Southeast Asia
and beyond.
